events.title: Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album "Abbey Road" was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Today marks 57 years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to 'Here Comes the Sun', which track is still on your heavy rotation?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, born Farrokh Bulsara, was born on this day in 1946.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury 80th Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. A true showman whose voice defined generations. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' lead singer Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today, having been born in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde 75th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders, what's your favourite track from one of music's most iconic voices?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher, born William John Paul Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher 54th Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock and roll swagger, what's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album "Imagine" was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years ago today, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace that still resonates. Which track from the album means the most to you?

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple dropped the device that changed everything for music lovers. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From the iconic theme tunes to the unforgettable gadgets, which Bond film or song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon 86th Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. A musical visionary whose legacy continues to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon track, solo or with The Beatles?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today, having been born in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese 87th Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles gave us the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. With its incredible diversity, which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Remembrance
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us in 1991. His legacy as one of music's greatest performers lives on. What's your favourite Freddie moment?

events.title: Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly pushed their sound. Which track from this classic still gets you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who left us in 1980. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's your most cherished John Lennon song?
